prompt:
超写实日本电车手机抓拍摄影，竖版 9:16。一名明确成年的东亚老年女性，约65–75岁，坐在日本城市通勤电车靠车门的蓝色优先座上。镜头位于人物正前方略偏左、略高于膝盖的位置，使用约 28–35mm 手机广角镜头，完整拍到头部、身体、交叉双腿和高跟鞋；人物占据画面主体，双腿从中部一直延伸至画面底部，带明显近大远小的手机抓拍透视。

人物留自然蓬松的银灰色短卷发，顶部略有体积，耳侧和后脑有柔软卷曲纹理。面部保留真实老年女性特征：轻微眼袋、法令纹、皮肤纹理和自然松弛感，不磨皮、不年轻化。五官端正精致，眉形清晰，淡眼妆，暗玫瑰豆沙色口红。她没有直视镜头，而是头部微微抬起，视线望向画面右上方，神情沉静、从容、略显高冷。

身材为成熟丰满的沙漏型体态：胸部明显丰满，腰腹自然，臀胯有真实宽度，大腿饱满，小腿匀称；不要生成纤瘦老年人体型，也不要夸张肥胖。

上身穿一件象牙白 / 奶白色低圆领修身吊带背心，柔软弹力面料紧贴身体，领口较低但自然覆盖。外搭一件黑白粗花呢短款小香风西装外套，密集黑白交织格纹，外套完全敞开，长度到腰部附近，袖口自然卷起少许。

下身穿黑色高腰皮质超短裙，表面为低调半哑光皮革质感，裙摆位于大腿上部。

双腿穿一条非常关键的烟黑色超薄透明连裤丝袜，约8–12D：必须明显透出真实肤色，不能生成厚黑袜；丝袜在大腿、膝盖、小腿胫骨与脚背处呈现细腻均匀的半透明烟灰黑色，带非常轻微自然丝光，材质贴肤，没有褶皱和塑料反光。

坐姿严格还原为高位翘腿 / 大腿交叉坐姿：一条腿完整搭在另一条腿上，交叉点位于大腿根部附近；上方腿从画面中央斜向右下方伸出，膝盖靠近镜头，另一条腿从座椅向前下方延伸。两条腿由于广角近距离拍摄显得修长且具有明显前后空间层次。

脚穿黑色亮面漆皮尖头细高跟鞋，鞋头非常尖长，约8–10cm细跟，鞋面前端带精致银色 / 水晶金属扣饰。丝袜完整延伸进入鞋内。

人物右手抬到右耳旁，手指轻轻整理银灰色卷发；左手自然落在交叉腿上方的大腿 / 膝盖附近。佩戴细小耳饰、纤细项链、手链或腕表，首饰克制而精致。

人物左侧座位上紧贴身体放着一只黑色柔软皮革大号手提包，自然塌陷并形成真实皮革褶皱。

场景必须是真实日本城市通勤电车内部。人物坐在深蓝色带细碎花纹的织物座椅上；左侧紧邻白色电车门，门边有弧形白色塑料结构与银色竖向扶手；车门附近地面露出醒目的黄色凸点盲道。地面为灰色耐磨车厢地板。

人物头部正后方墙面安装一块醒目的粉红色日本“優先席 / Priority Seat”标识牌，白色字体，下方带老人、孕妇、带幼儿乘客等简化图标。标识上方还有小型公益提示贴纸和广告。右侧紧挨另一名乘客，只显示部分深蓝 / 黑色羽绒外套和腿部，不抢主体。

车窗位于人物右后方，白天自然光从窗外进入，窗外能看到略微过曝的浅色城市建筑。整体采用车窗自然光＋车厢顶部冷白照明，人物面部和胸前较明亮，腿部逐渐进入稍暗区域。

摄影风格不要专业棚拍，而是普通乘客用手机临时拍下的一张真实照片：轻微广角畸变、自然曝光、有限动态范围、轻微噪点和手机锐化，背景保持较清楚，皮肤有毛孔与年龄纹理，丝袜、粗花呢、皮裙、漆皮鞋和蓝色座椅都具有真实材质细节。

重点锁定：老年东亚女性、65–75岁、银灰蓬松短卷发、成熟丰满体态、象牙白低领修身背心、敞开的黑白粗花呢短外套、黑色皮质超短裙、8–12D烟黑超薄透明连裤丝袜、高位翘腿、黑色尖头漆皮细高跟鞋、一手摸耳侧头发、黑色皮包、日本电车蓝色优先座、粉色“優先席 / Priority Seat”标识、黄色盲道、白天真实手机抓拍、28–35mm近距离透视。

避免：年轻女性面孔、少女感、过度磨皮、长发、厚重黑丝袜、不透明丝袜、网袜、裸腿、裤装、长裙、平底鞋、粗跟鞋、运动鞋、双腿并拢、站姿、错误翘腿结构、纤瘦纸片身材、夸张肥胖、摄影棚布光、强烈背景虚化、电影调色、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余手指、多余腿、畸形脚、水印。

promptTranslations.en:
Ultra-realistic candid smartphone photography inside a Japanese commuter train, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. An unambiguously adult East Asian elderly woman, approximately 65–75 years old, sits on a blue priority seat near the train doors of a Japanese urban commuter train. The camera is positioned slightly to the left directly in front of her, just above knee level, using an approx. 28–35mm smartphone wide-angle lens, fully capturing her head, body, crossed legs, and high heels; she occupies the main subject of the frame, with her legs extending from the center down to the bottom of the image, showing distinct wide-angle smartphone candid perspective (near-large, far-small foreshortening).

She has naturally voluminous, short, silver-gray curly hair with slight lift on top, and soft curly texture around the ears and nape. Her face retains authentic mature female features: subtle eye bags, nasolabial folds, natural skin texture, and slight slackness, without digital airbrushing or de-aging. Features are well-proportioned and refined, with defined eyebrows, subtle eye makeup, and muted rose/mauve bean-paste lipstick. Rather than looking directly at the camera, her head is tilted slightly upward with her gaze directed toward the upper right of the frame, bearing a calm, composed, slightly aloof expression.

Her build is a mature, voluptuous hourglass figure: noticeably full bust, natural waist and abdomen, authentic hip width, full thighs, and shapely calves; avoid an excessively skinny elderly frame, and avoid exaggerated obesity.

On her upper body, she wears an ivory / milky white low-scoop-neck form-fitting camisole tank top made of soft elastic fabric hugging her curves, with a low yet naturally covering neckline. Over it, she wears an open black-and-white tweed cropped Chanel-style jacket featuring a dense black-and-white houndstooth/plaid pattern; the jacket hangs completely unbuttoned, ending near the waist, with cuffs naturally pushed up slightly.

On her lower body, she wears a black high-waisted leather miniskirt with a discreet semi-matte leather texture, the hemline resting on her upper thighs.

Her legs are clad in essential smoky black ultra-sheer transparent pantyhose (around 8–12 denier): her genuine skin tone must visibly show through, never rendering thick opaque black tights; the stockings exhibit a delicate, even, translucent smoky charcoal-black tint across the thighs, knees, shins, and insteps, with an extremely subtle natural sheen, perfectly fitted to the skin without wrinkles or plastic reflections.

Her sitting posture is strictly rendered as a high-leg cross / thigh-crossed sitting pose: one leg fully draped over the other, crossing near the upper thigh; the top leg extends diagonally toward the bottom right from the center, knee positioned closer to the lens, while the other leg extends forward and downward from the seat. Due to the wide-angle close-up shot, her legs appear elongated with clear foreground-background depth.

On her feet are black glossy patent leather pointed-toe stiletto heels, featuring a very sharp elongated toe, an 8–10cm slender stiletto heel, and a delicate silver/crystal metallic buckle accent on the vamp. The sheer stockings extend fully into the shoes.

Her right hand is raised near her right ear, fingers gently adjusting her silver-gray curls; her left hand rests naturally on her crossed thigh/knee. She wears subtle small earrings, a delicate necklace, and a bracelet or wristwatch—restrained and tasteful jewelry.

Directly to her left on the seat rests a large, slouchy, soft black leather handbag, naturally collapsed with realistic leather folds and creases.

The environment must be an authentic Japanese urban commuter train interior. She sits on a navy blue fabric seat patterned with tiny subtle flecks; directly to her left is the white train exit door, framed by curved white plastic trim and a vertical silver grab pole; on the floor near the door, bright yellow raised tactile paving (blind track) is visible. The floor is textured gray commuter train flooring.

Directly behind her head on the wall panel is a prominent pink Japanese "優先席 / Priority Seat" sign with white lettering and simplified icons for the elderly, pregnant women, passengers with infants, etc. Above the sign are small public courtesy stickers and advertisements. To her immediate right sits another passenger, of whom only a portion of a navy/black down jacket and legs is visible, without distracting from the main subject.

A train window is located behind her to the right; daylight enters naturally from outside, revealing slightly overexposed, pale urban buildings. The lighting combines natural daylight from the window with the train's cool-white overhead ceiling fixtures; her face and chest are brightly lit, while her legs transition into slightly softer shadows.

The photographic style avoids professional studio lighting, resembling a genuine smartphone snapshot taken spontaneously by a fellow commuter: subtle wide-angle distortion, natural exposure, limited dynamic range, slight sensor noise and smartphone sharpening, a relatively sharp background, skin showing real pores and age lines, and realistic textures on the pantyhose, tweed, leather skirt, patent leather pumps, and blue fabric seat.

Key focal points: elderly East Asian woman, 65–75 years old, silver-gray voluminous short curly hair, mature voluptuous figure, ivory low-neck tight camisole, open black-and-white tweed cropped jacket, black leather miniskirt, 8–12D smoky black ultra-sheer pantyhose, high thigh cross pose, black pointed patent stilettos, hand touching hair by ear, black leather bag, Japanese train blue priority seat, pink "優先席 / Priority Seat" sign, yellow tactile paving, daylight authentic smartphone candid, 28–35mm close-range perspective.

Avoid: young female face, girlish appearance, excessive skin smoothing, long hair, thick black tights, opaque stockings, fishnets, bare legs, pants/trousers, maxi skirts, flat shoes, chunky heels, sneakers, legs parallel together, standing pose, anatomically incorrect leg-cross, thin cardboard-flat physique, exaggerated obesity, studio lighting, heavy bokeh, cinematic color grading, anime face, CG look, plastic skin, extra fingers, extra legs, deformed feet, watermark.

summaryTranslations.en: Ultra-realistic candid smartphone photography prompt of an elderly East Asian woman sitting on a priority seat inside a Japanese commuter train, covering outfit styling, seated pose, expression, and authentic carriage interior details.

translations.en: Hyper-realistic Japanese commuter train smartphone candid snapshot, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. An East Asian elderly woman, approximately 65–75 years old, sitting on the blue priority seat next to the train door. Low-angle 28–35mm wide-angle smartphone perspective, capturing her head, body, crossed legs, and high heels. The woman has natural, voluminous silver-grey short curly hair and authentic aging facial features including slight eye bags and skin texture without smoothing. Curvy hourglass figure wearing an ivory/off-white low-cut scoop-neck tank top, an unbuttoned black-and-white tweed cropped jacket, a black high-waisted leather miniskirt, and 8–12D ultra-sheer smoky black pantyhose over her crossed legs. Black pointed-toe patent leather stiletto heels with crystal-buckle accents. One hand rests near her ear touching her curls. A large black leather handbag rests next to her on the patterned blue fabric seat. Background features the authentic interior of a Japanese commuter train, including train doors, handrails, tactile yellow pavement tiles on the floor, and a prominent pink Japanese 'Priority Seat' sign directly behind her head. Natural daylight and fluorescent train lighting, authentic smartphone snapshot texture with slight wide-angle distortion and subtle noise.
